name: docmark_convert
description: Convert a document or image into clean Markdown (tables keep their rows and columns) via the DocMark API. Use when the user needs a PDF / Word (.docx/.doc) / PPT (.pptx/.ppt) / Excel (.xlsx/.xls) file or a screenshot (invoice, ID card, order — general OCR) turned into Markdown for a RAG pipeline, knowledge base, or downstream LLM; also use for scanned PDFs that have no text layer. Pass exactly one of: an existing local file path, a reachable http(s) file URL, or a taskId returned by a previous call. Documents over 10 pages are converted as an async task: the API returns HTTP 202 with a taskId and the script polls it automatically until the Markdown is ready, so the caller just waits and gets the Markdown. Use 'task' (plus poll=false to just fetch the current state) to resume a task across restarts without paying twice. Requires DOCMARK_API_KEY (get one at https://www.prowyg.com — new accounts get 100 free points). Billing: 1 page = 1 point, refunded automatically on failure; 202 already bills by page, so never resubmit a large file — resume with taskId instead. HTTP 402 = points insufficient (tell the user to top up), 401 = invalid key, 409 on the result endpoint = task not finished or failed. Not supported in key mode: .json/.html/.csv (HTTP 415). This tool parses documents only; it does not answer questions about them.

file.description: Path to an existing local file. Supported: .pdf .docx/.doc .pptx/.ppt .xlsx/.xls .jpg/.jpeg/.png/.bmp/.webp. Use this or 'url', never both.

url.description: Reachable http(s) URL of the file to convert (posted as JSON to /convert/url). Use this or 'file' or 'task', never more than one.

task.description: taskId returned by a previous call (HTTP 202 or no_poll=true). Resumes polling and returns the Markdown without resubmitting or charging again. Use this or 'file' or 'url', never more than one.

no_poll.description: Do not wait for a large document to finish. Returns the taskId JSON immediately (the pages are already billed), so the caller can resume later with 'task'. Default false: poll until succeeded. Ignored when 'task' is given.

out.description: Optional path to save the returned Markdown. Omit to receive the Markdown as text.
